description: This file defines the class MetaParser, a utility for parsing HTML forms, tables, scripts, and related elements within the context of SuiteCRM, extending SugarCRM. It includes methods for extracting form contents, form elements, attributes, tables, scripts, and merging panel data with master copies, as well as handling flavor-specific tags and fixing malformed tables.

classes.name: MetaParser
classes.description: A utility class for parsing and manipulating HTML content related to form and layout structures in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Stub method for parsing a file; returns 'NOT AVAILABLE' in this implementation.

methods.name: getFormContents
methods.description: Extracts all or first occurrence of form tags and their contents from HTML.

methods.name: getFormElements
methods.description: Parses contents to find input, select, and textarea tags.

methods.name: getFormElementsNames
methods.description: Extracts the 'name' attributes of form elements.

methods.name: getTagAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves specific attribute values from a tag's contents.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Returns tables in HTML content, optionally filtered by class.

methods.name: getElementsByType
methods.description: Extracts HTML elements of a specific type (e.g., <td>) with nested handling.

methods.name: getElementValue
methods.description: Gets the value enclosed within a specific element tag.

methods.name: stripComments
methods.description: Removes HTML comments from contents.

methods.name: stripFlavorTags
methods.description: Removes flavor-specific tags based on the global flavor setting.

methods.name: getMaxColumns
methods.description: Computes maximum number of <td> elements in a row.

methods.name: convertToTagElement
methods.description: Converts regex matches into structured tag elements with start, body, end.

methods.name: trimHTML
methods.description: Removes carriage returns, newlines, and tabs from HTML content.

methods.name: getJavascript
methods.description: Extracts JavaScript blocks and prepares them for rendering, with Smarty syntax conversions.

methods.name: parseDelimiters
methods.description: Processes JavaScript string to handle Smarty delimiters.

methods.name: findAssignedVariableName
methods.description: Attempts to parse PHP file to find assigned variable name for a field.

methods.name: dirList
methods.description: Lists files in a directory.

methods.name: getCustomField
methods.description: Checks if a form element is a custom field ending with '_c'.

methods.name: applyPreRules
methods.description: Loads and executes pre-parsing rules for a module.

methods.name: applyRules
methods.description: Placeholder to apply post-parsing rules, currently calls applyPostRules.

methods.name: applyPostRules
methods.description: Loads and runs module-specific and general parsing rules.

methods.name: createFileContents
methods.description: Generates PHP layout definition code with panels and metadata.

methods.name: mergePanels
methods.description: Merges layout panels based on master copy and existing layout, ensuring required fields are included.

methods.name: mergeTemplateMeta
methods.description: Merges template metadata with a master copy, handling JS paths.

methods.name: hasRequiredSpanLabel
methods.description: Checks if HTML contains required field labels.

methods.name: hasMultiplePanels
methods.description: Determines if the panels array contains multiple panels.

methods.name: getRelateFieldName
methods.description: Extracts field names related to a '_id' and '_name' pair.

methods.name: getCustomPanels
methods.description: Returns custom panels data.

methods.name: fixTablesWithMissingTr
methods.description: Fixes tables with missing <tr> tags.

methods.name: fixRowsWithMissingTr
methods.description: Fixes rows where </tr> is immediately followed by <td>.

methods.name: fixDuplicateTrTags
methods.description: Removes consecutive <tr> tags in HTML tables.

methods.name: findSingleVardefElement
methods.description: Determines if form elements contain a single vardef element.
